# iosxe_redundancy_application_group (Resource)

This resource can manage the Redundancy Application Group configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_redundancy_application_group" "example" {
  group_id           = 1
  name               = "cube-rg-1"
  priority           = 100
  failover_threshold = 75
  timers_delay       = 30
  timers_reload      = 60
  preempt            = true
  shutdown           = false
  tracks = [
    {
      object_number = "1"
      shutdown      = true
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) rg group id
  - Range: `1`-`2`

### Optional

- `control_interface` (String) Interface to be used as RG control interface
- `control_protocol` (Number) RG group protocol media
  - Range: `1`-`8`
- `data_interface` (String) RG group data interface
- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `failover_threshold` (Number) Failover Threshold
  - Range: `1`-`255`
- `name` (String) name string (25 chars. max)
- `preempt` (Boolean) RG group preempt
- `priority` (Number) Priority value
  - Range: `1`-`255`
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Shutdown the selected group
- `timers_delay` (Number) RG group delay timer. value in seconds
  - Range: `0`-`10000`
- `timers_reload` (Number) RG group reload timer. Value in seconds
  - Range: `0`-`10000`
- `tracks` (Attributes List) RG group tracking (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tracks))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--tracks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tracks`

Required:

- `object_number` (String) Tracked object number

Optional:

- `decrement` (Number) Decrement Value
  - Range: `1`-`255`
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Shutdown group

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_redundancy_application_group.example "<group_id>"
```
